g.text: How many people match 10 typed responses?
Target: no more than 140.3 dots RMS error. Dots show the smallest qualifying whole-person panel.
Lines show 95% respondent-bootstrap intervals, including uncertainty in the reference target.
Point estimates: 4-7 scale respondents match 10 typed-number respondents.
2,000 bootstrap draws resample whole people; the nine images stay fixed. Arrows indicate an upper bound beyond 100.
Intervals do not describe new questions. Bootstrap draws without a crossing are retained, not extrapolated.
Source: Honda, Kagawa & Shirasuna (2022) | Data: osf.io/sxdf9 | Analysis: 23 Sep 2026
